captions: Connect Claude to Sert trust, and you can issue and look up certificates just by asking.
In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, and choose Add, then Add custom connector.
Name it Sert trust, and enter the server address: A P I dot sert trust dot app, slash M C P.
Claude detects the sign in settings for you. Keep them, and add the connector.
Sign in to Sert trust, choose what Claude may do, and allow it. You can disconnect it at any time.
Claude now lists the Sert trust tools. By default, it asks before it uses each one.
Now just ask. For example: issue the Introduction to Data Analytics certificate to Anna Roo ease.
Claude shows exactly what it will issue, and waits for your approval.
And it is done. Anna gets her certificate by email. Connect your assistant at sert trust dot app.
